name: Yorda's Quest
storyline: The Demon Lord Veral has returned after being sealed away for 300 years... Legend tells of a hero who will come to save the world in its darkest hour, but there's just one problem: the world's been at peace for 300 years! Everyone forgot how to fight! And so, it's up to Yorda, a simple farmer with delusions of grandeur, to respond to the kingdom's call and rise up! Join him as he meets quirky characters and fights all manner of goofy monsters as he makes his way to becoming the hero of his dreams! From a farmer of crops to a farmer of EXP, Yorda departs!
summary: Laughs and legends await you! Join Yorda, the country bumpkin with hopes of heroism, on a light-hearted romp through the land! Fight demons, gain friends, and yuk it up in this parody of classic RPGs!
